title: Score the user's labelled real pages with extract-eval (REQ-0040); waits for the user's labelled pages
acceptance_criteria: AC1 gold stored outside solver inputs
AC3 extraction-only gold split to REQ-0078

design.summary: score saved DGNL runs against the official answers (scoring only), re-solve worst questions with the current engine, root-cause the remaining wrong answers

implementation.summary: no code: saved DGNL runs scored against the official answers, worst questions re-solved with the current engine, remaining wrong answers root-caused; evidence work/TASK-037/evidence/dgnl-score.txt

unit_test.command: independent recount of run3 per subject with the answer list (python, counts only)
unit_test.result: strict letter-match 26/29/27/22 of 30 matches the inspector; Science 29/30 after mapping the 7 value answers; no code changed

security.result: the answer list stayed untracked and was used for scoring only; only counts and question numbers were recorded

verification.command: scoring of saved DGNL runs against the official answers; current-engine re-solve of the worst questions; root-cause check against the PDF
verification.result: REQ-0040 AC1-AC3 verified: run3 111/120 correct (92.5 percent; 94.9 percent of answered); every answer UNCERTAIN, 0 PASS; current engine fixes 4 of 9 losses (Vietnamese 10, 14, 23, Math 66) -> projected 115/120; remaining wrong: Vietnamese 24 and Math 63 solver reasoning, Math 65 likely key oddity; limits: Math offset mapping matched 8 of 30 by text, English 38 and Science 112 not re-run, one exam

quality.reason: two independent counts of saved runs against the official answers; current engine re-solved against the same answers

verifier.waiver: two independent counts agree; no code to verify

crosscheck.waiver: independent oracle = the official answers: scoring counted twice (inspector and coordinator) with matching numbers; no generator under test

checkpoint.next: when the user gives the page path: run extract-eval on the labelled pages, measure accuracy and the OCR low_conf false-alarm share
